subject: Week0 kickoff: Maestro pilot MAP + slide draft
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <ldpark@maestro.ai>, Ben Howard <ben.h@maestro.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Week0 kickoff: Maestro pilot MAP + slide draft

Hi Lydia & Ben —

Great to connect last week. Per our call, attached is a first-pass Week0 mutual action plan (MAP) template I pulled together specifically for the Maestro pilot. The goal here is to make the first two weeks of the trial super predictable so your engineers can validate latency and inference costs on a representative workload while our team configures the private routing and KV caching settings.

Two quick asks from us to finalize the kickoff: 
- Can you confirm the three stakeholder names who will attend the Week0 technical sync? We recommend: Platform lead, Data engineer, and Product manager (30–45m).
- Please paste a single example prompt (or small corpus) you want us to prioritize for throughput profiling.

What I attached: 
- Maestro_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (editable) — Week0 tasks, owners, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
- Week0-kickoff-slides-v0.pptx — 4-slide stub for the intro sync (we'll tailor).

I put suggested owners in the doc for the first 10 tasks. Marissa, Jasmine — can you take ownership of the technical readiness checklist and the test data handoff items, respectively?

Proposed Week0 schedule (if helpful):
- Day 0: contract SOW signed, access request submitted (your SRE).
- Day 1: Redwood spins up a private endpoint + preflight tests.
- Day 2: Throughput profiling with your sample prompts, initial quality checks.
- Day 4: Joint sync to review metrics and tighten acceptance criteria.

I copied Naomi to help with any procurement or security evidence requests if they surface.

Thanks — aiming to have the finalized MAP doc by EOD Wed so we can lock the sync.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Maestro_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)]

Thanks Markus — this looks great and clear. A few notes from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: 
- Ben Howard (Platform Lead) — ben.h@maestro.ai
- Priya Suresh (Data Engineer) — priya.s@maestro.ai
- Omar Ruiz (Product Manager) — omar.r@maestro.ai

2) Example prompt set: I'll upload a short CSV with 200 representative queries (intent + user_message) to the shared folder by EOD today. Prioritize the longer-tailed prompts for latency profiling.

3) Week0 constraints: We need the initial endpoint reachable from our dev VPC (us-west-2). Also — our security team will ask for the SOC2 checklist and a short summary of data retention for KV caching. Can Naomi help route that?

4) Minor edits to MAP doc: Can you add an explicit rollback/fallback row in the acceptance criteria table (who will revert to hosted endpoint and what triggers it)?

Ben and I are available for the Day 2 throughput window between 10–12 PST.

Appreciate the quick turn, we'll review the doc and comment inline.

—Lydia

Head of Integrations, Maestro AI
ldpark@maestro.ai
